notes.title: I've Patched the Demo
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

I've pushed another patch to the goblinAmerica demo. It is not a big patch, it is a medium-sized patch. It does not add any new content. It contains lots of little tweaks and some changes to mechanics. Many of these are too small to even describe. Here are some that I can describe:

[list]
[*] [b]Improved gunplay.[/b] I've made some changes to how shooting works to make it a little more reliable and consistent. If you're aiming at a guy that you're close to, that bullet is hitting him. It will fry him. I hope this will reward players for having wonderful aim.

[*] [b]Added headshots.[/b] Shooting an enemy in the head will deal more damage and allow you to go even faster. It will make a distinctive sound and probably destroy them.

[*] [b]Enabled loadout changing in-game.[/b] You can now change your loadout from both the in-game pause menu and the end-of-run wrap-up screen. You no longer have to back out to the circular president-stretching devices to change your loadout. I hope this is nice. You still CANNOT change your loadout without restarting the level because that is NOT how this game works.
[/list]

As for me, I've been working on lots of things for the game. Levels...weapons...guys. None of that stuff is in the demo but you'll be able to play it soon. I think you'll like it.

It is a grey and rainy Sunday here in New York City. I hope the weather is nice wherever you are and that you are having a nice weekend.

I hope you enjoy this version of the demo. If anything in it is broken or feels horrible, please let me know.

Yours,
Gil

notes.title: New goblinAmerica Demo
notes.content:
Hello,

I just pushed an update to the goblinAmerica demo. This demo is structurally the same as the previous demo, but has new features, systems, areas, other secrets, and so on.

I did this partly just because, as I get closer to Early Access release, I wanted the demo to be more representative of the actual game. I'm also doing this because of some changes Steam made. The upshot is that there's now a dedicated page for the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616730/goblinAmerica_Demo/

If you enjoy the demo, please consider wishlisting it and leaving a good review for it on the demo page. These things help so much that it is, frankly, startling and bewildering.

Here's a summary of some of the major changes in the new demo.

[list]
[*] [b]Updated gear system.[/b] I have filled the world with items. Find them and put them on your heads and legs. Smear them on your body. They will make you better and worse at things, and sometimes have other stranger effects.

[*] [b]Use gear to break seals.[/b] I have added a new way to break seals for players that do not care to earn medals. Now you can progress by exploring, discovering things, using those things they discovered. I wanted to support players that prefer going slow to going fast. If you still prefer going fast, don't worry. You're still all set up.

[*] [b]Strangers with desires.[/b] I've added more complex people to the world. Some of them have things they'd like you to do. If you help them, things will change. Maybe you'll have long and beautiful friendships with them. I can't speak more on it.

[*] [b]Accessibility features.[/b] The big one is more granular settings for FoV stuff for people who struggle with motion sickness. Also added an option to keep the timer permanently hidden for people who don't need that looking over their shoulder. More of this kind of stuff coming with EA.

[*] [b]Weapon swapping.[/b] Now you can hold two weapons. And swap.

[*] [b]New areas.[/b] :)
[/list]

There are some other things too. Performance improvements, some tweaked behaviors, some secrets. I hope you enjoy.

Thanks,
Gil

p.s.: Some people who played the previous demo have run into a problem with their keybindings on playing this new demo. I think I fixed it, but if not, clearing the save and restarting the game should do it. And if you run into any bugs, let me know in the forums.

notes.title: goblinAmerica demo update #2
notes.content:
I just pushed a patch to the demo. Here are some of the most notable changes:

[list]
[*] Sunscorched wizards in the Undergunk and Moon Crypt emit a low hum.
[*] Wizard projectiles always repel you.
[*] UI reflects that it is impossible to summon God's Finger or begin conversations while airborne.
[*] The golden seal in Virginia demands less.
[*] Some fonts changed.
[*] Songs restart less frequently, especially in healthcare buildings and swamps.
[*] Interaction prompts reflect your preferred controller.
[*] Improved the legibility of flasks.
[*] The Sunship Wheel appears and disappears at normal times.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and playing. More soon. Go get'em.

notes.title: lil demo update for you
notes.content:
Hey, hope everyone is enjoying Steam Next Fest! It's been great hearing from people having fun with the demo, and I've appreciated all the kind words.

I'm pushing a patch with some minor bugfixes. The two worth noting are:

[list]
[*] Fix for crashing when trying to apply graphics settings on non-DLSS-compatible setups.
[*] Keybind overrides should now correctly persist between game sessions.
[/list]

I'm currently working on some changes (both small and large) that I intend to drop a little later in the week. If you run into any other problems in the meantime, please let me know! 

Also, I've been very impressed by some of the times you guys are putting up. If you take video of a good run or find a cool route, please share it with me—I'd love to see.

go get'em, goblin
